English සිංහල தமிழ் Fact Checked All Economy Society Environment Politics Health Methodology About Us Explore Fact-Checking Contact Us #false FactSeeker Debunks Viral Death Hoax About Pope Francis False Social media has been flooded with shocking claims that Pope Francis, the head of the Catholic Church and Vatican City, has passed away. The rumor has sparked widespread panic, with users sharing manipulated images and misleading reports. by Anonymous | February 24, 2025 A few days ago, international media reported that Pope Francis was in critical condition, fueling speculation about his health. As the buzz intensified, FactSeeker launched an investigation to uncover the truth. Upon verification, no official announcement has been made confirming the Pope’s death. Instead, credible news sources report that he is currently battling double pneumonia and receiving intensive care. Further analysis exposed a fact-checking report published by The Nigerian Voice, which debunked the viral claim. The report confirmed that an image circulating online—appearing to resemble one from the official Vatican News X account—was digitally manipulated to mislead the public. With no credible evidence supporting the claim, FactSeeker confirms that reports of Pope Francis’ death are completely false. The viral misinformation is yet another example of how easily fake news spreads in the digital age. We are an independent fact-checking team affiliated with the Sri Lanka Press Institute(SLPI). The objective and long-term goal of the FactSeeker is to provide the public with reliable and verified content in the attempt of debunking mis/disinformation. The unit, with the SLPI, is committed to contributing to improved media literacy in Sri Lanka.
